note: three rounds of a genuinely different approach, each documented in TRIED, before escalating - not three retries of the same fix.

card.title: Make the retry wrapper idempotent under FakeSh replay
card.body: <!-- sprint-meta risk=R2 spec=2026-09-10-roles-and-souls spec_sha256=deadbeef area=maintenance slug=t_3g4h5i6j -->

args.text: assumptions: FakeSh.calls is the only replay surface I can test against

args.reason:
BLOCKER: three approaches tried, none make the wrapper idempotent under FakeSh replay
TRIED: 1) memoizing on argv tuple - broke the timeout-retry case; 2) a per-call nonce - FakeSh has no nonce channel; 3) wrapping at the board_bridge call site instead of sh= - duplicates the wrapper at every caller
NEED: a decision on whether FakeSh needs a nonce channel added, or the wrapper moves up a layer
